claims.claim: Single-versus-joint guidance ablation is already directly present in T2I binding correction.
claims.boundary: Preference shares are not success rates. Fixed combined guidance does not establish instance-conditioned selection or a calibrated interaction predictor.

claims.claim: Structured phrase composition and final generation validation predate this candidate.

evidence.human_preference_filter: 20% most similar pairs removed in Table1; authors note full-set advantage may shrink, p17

claims.boundary: No low-budget per-instance held-out joint action outcome prediction in the reviewed method.

claims.claim: LEDITS++, Prism-Edit and PC-Edit already link internal signals and multi-edit preservation control.
anchors: Prism pp6-7 Eqs7-9 and p28 TableC6
claims.boundary: Do not frame them as heatmap-only. No reviewed protocol establishes the proposed few-shot action-response to unseen-combination final-fact calibration.

claims.claim: LayerEdit already identifies inter-object semantic/spatial conflicts and executes time-dependent joint editing.

evidence.signals: inversion-averaged object-token cross-attention combined with SAM and OneFormer masks, A-IoU threshold
evidence.action: SNR-dependent Bernoulli query/key removal per object layer; object-specific guidance; optimized transparency fusion

claims.boundary: Conflict estimate is attention-region overlap, not empirically estimated final-image action effect. Module ablations are not unseen-pair prediction. Authors call framework training-free while optimizing inference-time transparency weights.

claims.claim: SplitFlow uses actual short sub-trajectories and velocity relations for compositional editing, not merely a static concept map.
claims.boundary: No final-fact success/harm predictor, held-out pair forecasts, or equal-total-budget candidate choice study found in reviewed sections. Source TableS4 p16 labels conflict with p10 and AppendixE prose; runtime figures are author-reported and not our measured cost.

claims.claim: IID already uses per-instruction responses and an influence score to arrange a compositional edit.

evidence.signal: head-wise attention difference; average within edit region determines influence score
evidence.decision: ascending instruction order; latent region blending and constrained attention
evidence.evaluation: MagicBrush535 sessions plus50 real-world scenarios; OmniGen and private-finetuned FluxEdit

claims.boundary: Influence score is not an empirical final-image causal effect. Reviewed arXiv v1 is14pages; discovered longer ICLR2026 OpenReview revision was not fully reviewed. No assertion of acceptance or exhaustive version coverage.

claims.claim: PCI already measures real single-versus-joint concept insertion curves.

evidence.interaction_example: female + sketch shifts insertion window later; many other pairs approximately compositional

claims.boundary: Actual combined-prompt generation is more direct than explainer-only interaction. Each concept is scored separately; no few-probe prediction of untested combinations found in these pages.

claims.claim: Metagame T2I coalition values are cached-logit softmax operations rather than regenerated interventions.
claims.boundary: Higher-order or directional attribution mathematics is not a new contribution here. Its T2I segmentation does not establish joint-action repair effects.

claims.claim: Candidate-specific remaining gap is few-observation prediction of untried final-image action benefit and harm, with equal-cost decision value.
claims.boundary: Absence from this read corpus is not proof of novelty; mere finite difference plus search is insufficient. No T2I experiments run.

claims.claim: Pairwise interactions should be tested as an incremental module of a simpler conditional action selector.
claims.boundary: Do not require VLM wins. Do not prefer higher-order models without measured marginal predictive and decision value.

minimum_experiment.task: one fixed-backbone multi-object attribute editing task; generation and source-image editing not pooled
minimum_experiment.information_control: same fixed probe trace and end-image feedback; freeze predictions before hidden action completion is revealed
minimum_experiment.decision_control: same total cost, same candidate menu; also compare native full-method baselines separately
minimum_experiment.primary_endpoint: all requested edits correct and pre-specified initially-correct facts preserved
stop_interaction_if: no meaningful safe pair oracle gain over best single/fixed combination
response features do not outperform simple geometry and gradient baselines
prediction advantage does not translate into equal-cost decision gain

decision.priority_vs_simple_selector: not_higher; use as nested incremental hypothesis
decision.already_solved: joint editing, conflict localization, direction aggregation, and some single/joint ablations already exist
decision.unproven: instance-specific unseen-action final-outcome prediction with net decision benefit
decision.iclr_accept_assessment: insufficient evidence at idea stage; plausible paper only if concrete new signal/structure plus strong predictive and decision results; no acceptance guarantee
